subject: Re: Payment terms for pilot — staggered net terms & VAT coordination
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greenwavehealth.com>

Cc: jorge.martinez@greenwavehealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payment terms for pilot — request

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our procurement team has asked for a formal payment proposal for the 3-month integration pilot. Because we are an NHS-affiliated EU entity, procurement prefers Net60 on initial pilots to preserve cash runway.

We can provide a PO in advance and are prepared to put a 25% upfront deposit on the first invoice. Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood accept Net60 for the pilot with an upfront 25% deposit?
- We need clarity on VAT handling — whether Redwood will issue invoices to our EU entity (reverse-charge) or if local VAT is collected.

If Net60 is not possible, please propose alternatives (e.g., staged milestone invoices).

Best,
Sara Liu
Head of Procurement
Greenwave Health
[Attachment: PO_DRAFT_GW-1457.pdf (application/pdf, 78KB)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Payment terms for pilot — request

Sara —

Really appreciate the clarity and the PO draft. Short answer: we can be flexible, but we have two operational constraints to balance — credit exposure on a Net60 and VAT evidence for the EU reverse-charge.

Proposed balanced approach (we call it a "staggered netterm + sweephold"):
1) 25% upfront deposit (as you suggested) paid on signature.
2) Remaining 75% will be invoiced in two tranches: 45% due Net30 and 30% due Net60 (effectively giving you a blended term while reducing our full exposure).
3) Credit cap: Redwood would set an interim credit cap equal to the outstanding contract value minus the deposit (i.e., 75% of pilot value) while pilot is active. We can agree to automatic hold/fallback to a shorter term if invoices age beyond agreed milestones.
4) VAT: If your EU entity can provide a valid EU VAT registration / reverse-charge certificate (attached below), Redwood will zero-rate the invoice (reverse-charge) and mark the invoice accordingly. If we do not receive valid VAT evidence before first invoice, we will apply standard VAT to the invoice and process a correction once evidence is provided.

I copied Marissa (AM) and Naomi (AR) so we can finalize the credit cap and invoice cadence. If that structure works, I’ll prepare an SOW with milestone billing and a DocuSign route.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Jonas —

AR side is comfortable with the proposed staggered split, with the following guardrails:
- Interim credit cap: 100% of outstanding invoices but limited to the contracted pilot value (75% after deposit). We want a PO before the first invoice and a billing contact for collections.
- Trigger for hold: any invoice > 45 days past due will automatically move the account to prepay for subsequent invoices until aging cleared.
- VAT corrections: Yes — Finance can issue a VAT-corrected invoice once a valid EU VAT registration / reverse-charge cert is received; we will require the certificate before issuing the second invoice to avoid extra processing.

I attached the AR checklist and the template we need for VAT evidence.

Naomi Feldman

Thanks for the thought-through proposal. We can accept the staggered 25% / 45% Net30 / 30% Net60 split if Redwood can:

Jorge / Sara —

Thanks — appreciate the quick follow-up and for sending the VAT cert. Confirming Redwood agrees to the targeted operational language below; I’m pasting the payment schedule we will include in the SOW:

Payment schedule (pilot contract value = 100%):
- Invoice 1: 25% due on signature (paid within 5 business days).
- Invoice 2: 45% issued 30 days after Invoice 1, due Net30. Redwood will not charge VAT on Invoice 2 (reverse-charge) if valid VAT evidence is on file prior to issuance.
- Invoice 3: 30% issued 60 days after Invoice 1, due Net60. If VAT evidence is not yet on file before Invoice 2, Redwood will apply VAT and issue a correction once evidence is received — AR will coordinate for a corrected invoice to support your reclaim.

Credit & hold mechanics:
- Interim credit cap set to 75% of pilot value (outstanding after deposit).
- Automatic hold trigger: any invoice > 45 days past due, unless Greenwave has opened a ticket with AR confirming administrative delay within 5 business days of the due date. If administrative ticket is logged, AR will extend the aging cure window by 15 calendar days.

I attached the SOW (payment table embedded) and a DocuSign link. If this looks good I’ll send for signature and push the first invoice on signature.

Regards,
